decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the page-limit goal and the instruction to notify the client if it cannot be met.
Adjusting spacing to meet the page limit does not necessarily change required photo selection or photo integration.
The page-limit layout constraint does not change the selected brand identity or available brand assets.
The source does not remove or alter the requirement to include and format the supplied tables.
Fitting the document within its page limit does not change the required PDF format, file count, email submission, or export quality.
The source calls for spacing and layout adjustments, not changes to narrative integration or the fixed section order.
The page-limit constraint does not alter Canva source access, editability, ownership, or asset policy.
Changing document spacing does not entail any change to the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ document and does not affect the TPEC proposal.
The page-limit layout instruction does not change the agreed number of revision rounds.
The source introduces no change to draft, revision, submission, or final-delivery dates.
